observations.title: Customize a menu in the built-in editor
observations.player_action: Open FancyMenu's layout editor and arrange supported screen elements.
observations.outcome: Menu positions, textures and animated elements can be personalized through saved layouts.
conditions: Menu layout is presentation; it must not replace protected native gameplay interfaces without approval.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.

observations.title: Conditionally display menu elements
observations.player_action: Use supported layout loading requirements, variables and placeholders.
observations.outcome: Menu content can change with the declared conditions rather than requiring a separate screen for every state.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.

observations.title: Open a supported GUI from the server
observations.player_action: Use the optional server-side FancyMenu functionality for a client with the mod installed.
observations.outcome: The server can request a configured client GUI to open.
conditions: A client GUI opening does not by itself validate or execute server gameplay actions.
